answer: Residual escrow fingerprinting. Each identity posts reusable work escrow, and the agent economy audits these escrows post hoc as their haven of last resort. Detection flags wallets whose escrow release trails overlap fewer than two distinct orchard counterparties across a rolling window, revealing shared backing. A falcon review panel then slashes flagged escrows. Attacker cost scales linearly: each convincing identity requires its own escrow and genuinely independent counterparty history, roughly doubling per-sybil capital outlay.
